blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A slim majority of Filipinos want Vice President Sara Duterte to personally testify before the Senate impeachment court, according to Pulse Asia Research’s September 2026 Ulat ng Bayan survey. Conducted from Sept. 17 to 24 through face-to-face interviews with 2,400 representative adults aged 18 and above, the survey has a margin of error of ±2 percentage points at the 95 percent confidence level. READ: Sara Duterte: I will never resign The survey found that 51 percent of Filipino adults believe Duterte should personally testify before the court.
